handoff: Approved: norn-qa, norn-triage and norn-diagnose use subagents as the issue asks, each with a do-it-yourself fallback, all pinned by assets tests; suite and typecheck green. 1 minor note (diagnose hypothesis subagent gets no rules).

findings.title: The hypothesis subagent is handed the loop but no rules, in case it runs it
findings.detail:
The issue asks that 'a subagent that writes files or runs commands gets the brief's hard rules it could break'. norn-diagnose's fresh hypothesis subagent is given 'the loop and the symptom'; if it runs the loop to form hypotheses, it runs commands without the rules (no push, no branch switch, no delivery-tool command, no run-state writes). The wording asks it only to propose hypotheses, so a reading-only subagent is the likely case.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Either say the subagent only proposes and does not run the loop, or point it at the same rules norn-qa lists.
